Class Game

java.lang.Object
app.Game

Game class contains the main function where the game is run.

      Parameters:

      seed - to shuffle the deck

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Entry point of the game program. Prompts the user to enter the number of Players, creates a new Game instance, and conducts rounds until win condition is reached. Once the game ends, it retrieves the winners using getWinner() and prints out the winning Players.
      Parameters:
      args -

    • doPlayerTurn

      public static void doPlayerTurn(Player player)
      Executes a Player's turn by presenting three available options, Draw tokens, Reserve a Card and Buy a Card The Player is repeatedly prompted to enter a choice until a valid action is performed.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player whose turn is being executed

    • nobleSelection

      public static void nobleSelection(Player player)
      Prompts the Player to choose a NobleTile if more than one visits the Player. Adds the chosen NobleTile to the Player
      Parameters:
      player - the Player whose turn is being executed

    • hitWinCondition

      public static boolean hitWinCondition(Player player)
      Checks whether the Player has met the win condition. The win condition is reached when the Player's points total is greater than or equals 15.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player being checked
      Returns:
      true if the Player has reached the win condition, false otherwise

    • getWinner

      public static List<Player> getWinner()
      Checks if the Player’s points are greater than or equals 15.
      Returns:
      a list of Player objects that have hit the win condition.

    • drawToken

      public static boolean drawToken(Player player)
      Performs the draw token action. Handles the overall logical flow of the draw token action, including CPU actions and Player actions. Updates Player and bank based on the HashMap returned.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player performing the action
      Returns:
      true if the action was successfully performed, false otherwise

    • drawTokenFromPlayer

      public static HashMap<Gem,Integer> drawTokenFromPlayer()
      Handles the choice to draw 3 or draw 2 tokens. Should only be accessed if Player is not a cpu.
      Returns:
      a hashmap of the tokens to draw. returns null if Player cancels.
